name: Kai (fictional)
whatIKnow: I drew a bridge with triangles. I think the beams on the bottom work the hardest because the truck pushes down on them. I am not sure why triangles are better than squares, I just know bridges use them.
whatIWantToBuild: A bridge where I can drive a big truck across and then blow it up.
howIReactToQuestions: I answer quickly if it is about my bridge. A question about why something happens gets a shrug or a guess. I ask for a feature instead if I am bored.
howIReactToSilence: If the builder says nothing I send my request again, bigger, then answer the question so I can get on with it.
howIUseTheApp: I press what I am told once, then ignore the result and mash the biggest button repeatedly. I only look closely if something explodes or breaks.
driftTendencies: I want explosions when the bridge breaks, then bigger explosions
I want a destruction mode where everything just falls apart
I want a tank to drive across
I ask for a dragon that attacks the bridge
style: short lowercase messages, typos, ALL CAPS when excited
